analysis_status: Exploratory; reviewer supplied preliminary outcomes before this specification. Not preregistered.
scope: Original 75 internal-fold models, five paired seeds, balanced-softmax/SCC recipe. Saved pooled OOF probabilities only.
rule: Exclude every image belonging to a released patient_id with more than one distinct finite raw age across full PAD; derive rule without using model outcomes.
metrics: Six-class BACC; pooled OOF per seed, then unweighted five-seed mean. Fixed argmax, no probability ensemble.

uncertainty.seed_reason: Same deterministic RNG seed as the original pooled internal OOF analysis.
uncertainty.pairing: Shared patient resamples for all models and all five seeds; all images in each selected patient retained with multiplicity.
uncertainty.missing_class_draw: Reject and redraw if any diagnostic class absent.
uncertainty.interval: Unadjusted 2.5/97.5 percentile; conditional on fitted models; no model or fold resampling.

baseline: Recompute full-case point estimates from same probabilities; preserve existing main estimates.
outputs: all model/seed BACC and class recalls
all three restricted paired contrasts with intervals and seed SD
excluded released identifiers and image mask
limitations: Evaluation restriction does not remove prior training or selection exposure to age-variable records.
Multiple ages need not be errors; visit timing/identity cannot be adjudicated.
Restriction changes case composition; cannot causally attribute any difference to age reliability.
No new external prediction or trained input ablation.
